description: Fit a regularized logistic regression using sklearn, treating each mouse as a group for cross-validation hyperparameter selection. Only training mice (IDs) are used for fitting and hyperparameter tuning (via GroupKFold cross-validation). Categorical history features (choices, feedbacks) are numerically encoded as provided. Data is standardized on train only, including contrasts and block prior, using means/stds from training mice. The best C (inverse regularization strength) is chosen by mouse-disjoint log-loss. Predict turnCW probability for each test example (from test-only mice), with deterministic RNG for reproducibility. All code fits in <240 lines, uses only allowed numpy, scipy, and sklearn, and does not reference any session info or joining. Probabilities are clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6] as per scoring protocol. The design fairly estimates generalization to new mice by exclusively holding test-mouse data separate throughout all model selection and fitting.
